item.title: Business skips left on pavement/blocking access for days, 1st October
item.description:
Catford and Cyphers Cricket Club have left their business skips outside their property on the pavement/public street for the whole week, not just for bin days. This keeps happening and nothing is being done about it. The club always say they only leave them out for collection and then put them back in but unless collection takes 3-5 days then this is not the case. It blocks the pavement, creates an eyesore and encourages flytipping. The club clearly does not care as they have been asked about his multiple times. Please remind them of their responsibilities/fine them. (Example image attached)

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Cameron Road, Perry Vale, Greater London
